title: Scenario Open-Sources 1,300+ 3D Models on Hugging Face
summary:
Scenario has released a collection of 39 GB of 3D files for free download on Hugging Face. The dataset contains more than 1,300 models under a CC BY 4.0 license, with GLB files featuring textures up to 8K.

The assets were generated on Scenario using various tools, including Claude Opus 5.5 3D, GPT-6 Astra 3D, Hitem3D, Meshy, Rodin, and Tripo. Each example includes the input image, prompt, and settings used for creation, while the Opus and Astra models provide native Blender files.
